_about: Where the House finds things. No secret is ever in this file: tokens come from the environment or the box's .env.

options_structures._about: Which book the options desk's structures trade on (the House reads `book`): options-shadow, the House's own practice account over live OPRA quotes (league/options_shadow.py), or alpaca-paper, the Alpaca practice account's multi-leg route. The shadow account's starting_cash matters only when options-shadow.json does not exist yet: 20 structure agents' practice stakes of $200 are $4,000.
options_structures._about_practice_account: Wave 2 (Sept 25, 2026): true sends each structure agent whose program's PARAMS["structure"] is one of the five types the Alpaca practice account can close as ONE covered multi-leg order (debit_vertical, credit_vertical, iron_condor, iron_butterfly, long_butterfly) to alpaca-paper; every other structure agent stays on `book`. An agent holding structures on its old book keeps trading there until flat (opens through one full session, then closes only), then its practice stake moves (House._structure_move). Keep `book` at options-shadow. False: every structure agent on `book`, as before. Deploy G ships it false; turn it on ONLY in a later release that changes nothing but this key, and undo it the same way (a release setting it false). NEVER roll back past Deploy G while alpaca-paper holds a structure: the older code cannot read the account's legs (alpaca-paper freezes for every agent) and its wind-down sells a structure as its first leg alone, a naked short (House._structure_practice_account).

_about_options_history_daily_expiries: The review of Deploy G (Sept 25, 2026): true makes the House's daily options-history refresh ingest EVERY expiry of SPY, QQQ and IWM (league/options_history.py DAILY_EXPIRIES) and backfill them across the replay window once; false keeps the weekly refresh (the last expiry of each week), as before G. Deploy G ships it false. Turn it on ONLY in a later release that changes nothing but this key, in an announced, watched quiet slot (the backfill holds an ops slot for tens of minutes and thousands of gateway GETs), recording House RSS and tick time during it and at the first every-expiry structure tape. Once the store holds every expiry, NEVER roll back past Deploy G without first deleting the non-weekly SPY/QQQ/IWM bars: the older code's tape has no weekly filter and would build tapes about four times the size (House._options_history_daily_expiries).

performance._about: The record's first point. start_equity was reset on Sept 19, 2026 (the owner's decision) to what the two real accounts held that afternoon, before the league's first real trade; the public chart draws start_equity plus the league's own real-money result.

jev._about: Jev as the cheap sensor (league/sensors.py) and the move sensor (league/jev_features.py). The caps are one daily pool per UTC day across every purpose: $1.50 and 25,000 calls, aligned to the ~$25 funded Jev balance (Sept 25, 2026). The move sensor serves a free model (no Jev) for every shown market and spends at most move.daily_usd ($0.75) on Jev: static labels once per market for the Jev shadow model, then a paced sample of states. The gateway's lifetime allowance stays the authority. Set enabled false to run the House exactly as before.

research_gate._about: after, max_factor and sample_percent are the v0 dials in game.json research.gate; game.json research.gate.enabled false turns every research gate off.

lab._about: The Alpha Lab's own Sailbox (scripts/lab_box.py): sealed like an agent box, larger than one. LabBox.from_config binds box_id into the House's sandbox under box_key.
